newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance share falls after results.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance share falls after results.

text.p: Shares of Reliance Industries Ltd fell in afternoon trade on Tuesday as traders took profits after the petrochemical giants announced higher profits for 1996/97 (April-March), brokers said.
"The results are above expectations," said Rasesh Maniar, a dealer at brokerage Mukesh Babu Securities Ltd.

Reliance's net profit grew to 13.23 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 13.05 billion a year ago. Consensus estimate of 28 leading securities and brokerage houses had placed the net profit lower at 12.06 billion rupees.
Maniar said players were booking profits because there was little fresh news to fuel the rally.
At 0825 GMT the share was trading at 311.50 rupees, down from 320.25 earlier and compared to Monday's 10 percent rise to 307.75 on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
The last day of weekly account on the National Stock Exchange also set off some selling. The share was traded at 307.85 rupees against a high at 318 and compared to 299.30 at Monday's close.
